description: The VALUE clause's Format-3 WHEN SET TO FALSE phrase (ISO 13.18.63.2 format 3 - the bracket [ WHEN SET TO FALSE IS literal-4 ] printed on the line after [ IN alphabet-name-1 ]). literal-4 is the value 13.18.63.4 GR20 places in the conditional variable for 'SET condition-name TO FALSE', and 13.18.63.3 SR27 screens it against the condition's own VALUE set (COBOL2048). A COBOL-2002 addition, with the SET Format-4 FALSE phrase it exists to feed - DERIVED, not quoted: the 2023 Annex E carries no 85->2002 VALUE row (the A1 authority gap, D18), and the reserved-word evidence cannot date it because FALSE is already reserved at 85 for EVALUATE. Recognition-fired by VersionConformancePass.ParseArm.VisitValueClauseFalsePhrase: the binder abandons the operand on every 13.18.63.3 SR violation, so a bound-arm gate would lose the 0900 on exactly those paths (the TYPEDEF drop-proof lesson). kb/Work PB555.
display: the VALUE clause's WHEN SET TO FALSE phrase
vcr: Condition-name WHEN SET TO FALSE phrase (COBOL-2002); A1 authority-sufficiency gap (D18)

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. VMVALFP.
DATA DIVISION.

01 CV PIC 9 VALUE 1.
   88 CN VALUE 1 WHEN SET TO FALSE IS 7.
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
MAIN.
    IF CN DISPLAY "Y" ELSE DISPLAY "N" END-IF.
    STOP RUN.
